"A wonderous delight sent by the gods of above. Providing essence and love to all. They're also worth money, try selling them!"

Stars

Stars are a resource and material in Oaklands. They spawn at night, and come in 5 different colors, similarly to fireflies. Stars can also be used as a building material, taking the form of a colored forcefield material when placed into a schematic. Stars fall from the sky at night. Every night has a 1 in 5 chance of being a star rain, which greatly increases the amount of stars that fall. They can be sold at the Resource Hub.

Stars come in 5 colors, each of a different value and rarity.

Star Chances
Yellow, common rarity, has a ~84% or ~8/10 spawn chance.
Green, common rarity, has a 10% or 1/10 spawn chance.
Red, common rarity, has a 5% or 1/20 spawn chance.
Blue, uncommon rarity, has a 0.9% or roughly ~1/100 spawn chance
Purple, rare rarity, is the rarest variant. Has a <0.1% or 1/1000 spawn chance.


Note that the frequency of star spawns depend upon the weather:

  • During stormy conditions (such as rainy or thunderstorm), star spawning is reduced by about 0.5X.
  • A clear night has a 1/5 chance to be a meteor shower/star rain, where stars spawn 2X more than usual.
  • Any stars that are not claimed will disappear at 6:30.

Trivia

  • Stars resemble Star Bits from Super Mario Galaxy. The original suggestion on Discord was actually based upon Star Bits.
  • When viewing the description of a star, it shimmers with all the colors of the rainbow.
  • Blue and Purple Stars have high trading value - it is not recommended to sell them; make a trade with them instead!
  • You can save rare stars when filling out schematics by using Yellow Stars. For example, fill a schematic up to 90-95% with Yellow Stars; then, put a Purple Star in to complete the schematic. If done correctly, the schematic will form a material from the rarer variant - useful if you want to do a big project needing a lot of rare stars.
